verdict.rationale: Poly ships a built-in agent you can ask to summarize, explain, or edit your files (poly-docs-31), and it handles multi-step tasks across reading, searching, writing, and organizing (poly-docs-14). It also builds a 'second brain' of key details from your files (poly-docs-3) and offers natural-language search inside file content (poly-docs-2), so the core of getting AI-derived insight from your data inside the product is documented. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI suggestions or surfaced insights the user did not ask for, deeper documentation of insight-style outputs beyond summarize/explain, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-product agent's quality.
